scenarios.profile: Independent with most ADLs; occasional cue/setup; stable mobility
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Baseline L1 tasks only; promote independence
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Routine review

scenarios.profile: Needs regular assistance with bathing/dressing; ambulates with limited support
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: ADL assistance + mobility support as assessed
scenarios.expectedEscalation: DT-003 if material change; reassessment

scenarios.profile: History of falls/near-falls; needs transfer/ambulation support
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Transfer + ambulation + fall-prevention controls
scenarios.architectureResult: Architecture passes; frequency needs clinical approval

scenarios.profile: Needs frequent cueing/supervision; occasional unsafe judgment
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Cognitive cueing + supervision + ADL/mobility support
scenarios.expectedEscalation: DT-003; DT-007 where applicable

scenarios.profile: Requires assessed meal assistance and swallowing precautions
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Meal assistance + clinically specified observation

scenarios.profile: Needs authorized medication support and observation
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Medication support + variance/adverse-effect monitoring

scenarios.profile: Returns with changed function and medication changes
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Temporary enhanced monitoring + reconciliation + reassessment

scenarios.profile: Multiple ADL dependencies and extensive transfer support
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Enhanced ADL + transfer + ambulation tasks

scenarios.profile: Significant cognitive impairment, supervision and behavioral triggers
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Comprehensive cognitive/behavioral supervision + ADL/mobility support
scenarios.expectedCareEvents: Behavioral escalation, acute change, injury risk

scenarios.profile: Reduced mobility and identified skin risk requiring clinical plan
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Skin observation + prevention tasks + mobility/ADL support
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Clinical review; DT-003
scenarios.architectureResult: Architecture passes; wound protocol required if applicable

scenarios.profile: Reduced intake requiring monitoring and assistance
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Meal/hydration support + intake observation
scenarios.expectedCareEvents: Persistent poor intake or dehydration concern
scenarios.expectedEscalation: DT-003; reassessment
scenarios.architectureResult: Architecture passes; threshold needs clinical approval

scenarios.profile: Comfort-focused goals with symptom monitoring
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Comfort-focused ADL/nutrition/skin/clinical tasks
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Clinical escalation/review

scenarios.profile: Resident has progressively reduced intake over several days with emerging weight decline but no acute instability.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Generate NUT-103/NUT-105 and level-appropriate hydration/intake support; preserve choice and identify baseline change.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Review intake trend, assess contributing factors and escalate nutrition/clinical review according to approved thresholds.
scenarios.architectureResult: Expected pathway: baseline → trend event → review; threshold validation pending.

scenarios.profile: Resident coughs during meals and has a documented texture modification requirement.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Generate NUT-204 plus applicable meal-assistance tasks; require texture/feeding precautions and competency gate.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Stop unsafe feeding approach, notify nurse/clinical lead and follow approved swallowing pathway.
scenarios.architectureResult: Expected hard safety gate; clinical protocol thresholds pending.

scenarios.profile: Resident is on a comfort-focused plan with reduced appetite and variable fluid tolerance.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Generate NUT-401–NUT-405 according to goals; avoid automatic intake targets that conflict with comfort goals.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Clinical/goals-of-care review when tolerance, symptoms or goals change.
scenarios.architectureResult: Expected goal-aligned pathway; local palliative policy validation pending.

scenarios.profile: Resident develops a new symptom not part of the established baseline.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Generate CLN-103/CLN-004 as applicable; capture symptom details and initiate change-in-condition logic.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Assess significance and escalate for clinical review according to approved protocol.
scenarios.architectureResult: Baseline comparison → event → assessment → escalation/review; thresholds pending clinical validation.

scenarios.profile: A scheduled vital sign is outside the resident's individualized parameter.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Capture CLN-E02; require parameter comparison and clinical response workflow; do not hard-code universal thresholds.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Verify measurement as appropriate, assess context, escalate according to individualized parameters/protocol.
scenarios.architectureResult: Hard parameter gate; actual thresholds remain clinical-policy dependent.

scenarios.profile: Resident returns from hospital and shows increased weakness and reduced intake compared with discharge baseline.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Generate CLN-203 plus cross-domain monitoring; link nutrition/mobility events and consider care-plan reassessment.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Clinical review and transition-of-care reassessment if deterioration is identified.
scenarios.architectureResult: Expected cross-domain synthesis and DT-009/DT-003 pathway.

scenarios.profile: Resident shows simultaneous cognitive, mobility and nutrition changes over several days.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Generate CLN-303/CLN-304; link events across domains and evaluate care-level change.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Trigger clinical/care-plan reassessment and determine whether level/tasks require change.
scenarios.architectureResult: Expected multi-domain trigger rather than isolated task escalation.

scenarios.profile: Resident has worsening symptoms despite the current comfort plan.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Generate CLN-402/CLN-405; support timely clinical review and goal-of-care alignment.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Escalate for clinical review; assess whether goals, interventions or service capability need change.
scenarios.architectureResult: Expected comfort-focused escalation without automatic curative treatment assumptions.

scenarios.profile: Resident develops new urinary incontinence not present at baseline.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Generate SKN-102/SKN-105; capture pattern change and assess whether clinical review is required.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Assess new pattern and escalate according to approved clinical protocol.
scenarios.architectureResult: Expected baseline comparison → event → assessment → plan/task adjustment.

scenarios.profile: Resident develops a new open area or pressure-related skin concern.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Generate SKN-202/SKN-204; capture skin event and initiate clinical review.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Clinical assessment and prevention/plan review.
scenarios.architectureResult: Expected skin-integrity gate; exact clinical staging/thresholds remain policy-dependent.

scenarios.profile: Reduced mobility, poor intake and increased incontinence jointly increase skin breakdown risk.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Link SKN-203 with nutrition/mobility prevention tasks; create cross-domain event.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Integrated care-plan review and prevention escalation.
scenarios.architectureResult: Expected cross-domain synthesis rather than isolated skin task.

scenarios.profile: Resident with dementia repeatedly resists toileting and becomes incontinent.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Generate SKN-301/SKN-304; adapt approach while preserving dignity and avoiding unsafe coercion.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Review communication/behavior approach and care plan.
scenarios.architectureResult: Expected cognition-aware task adaptation and event capture.

scenarios.profile: Resident receiving comfort-focused care develops moisture-related skin discomfort.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Generate SKN-401/SKN-404; align intervention with comfort goals and escalate if symptoms are uncontrolled.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Clinical review if comfort cannot be maintained within current plan.
scenarios.architectureResult: Expected comfort-focused response; no automatic curative pathway.

scenarios.profile: Mostly independent; occasional setup/cueing; no material safety or clinical complexity.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Should remain L1; baseline tasks only.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Needs regular help with bathing, dressing and toileting; mobility mostly stable.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Should classify L2; regular ADL/continence tasks.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Uses assistive device; regular transfer assistance; otherwise stable and cognitively intact.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Should remain L2 if safety needs are manageable within L2 package.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Requires regular assistance with bathing, dressing, toileting, eating and transfers; stable clinically.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Should reach L3 through cumulative dependency.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Regular ADL support and high fall risk; no major clinical complexity.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Critical test: high fall risk should add controls, not automatically inflate level.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Recent hospitalization; increased monitoring temporarily needed; ADL needs remain moderate.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Should trigger enhanced monitoring/transition tasks; level may change if needs persist.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.modifiers: MOD-CLN-01 as applicable; MOD-SKN-01 if risk evidence exists
scenarios.profile: Multiple chronic conditions, frequent monitoring, several ADL dependencies, but cognition stable.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Should classify L3 with enhanced clinical monitoring.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Substantial cognitive impairment, frequent supervision, behavioral support and multiple ADL dependencies.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Should classify L4 due to comprehensive supervision/cognitive complexity.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Cognitive impairment plus mobility, fall, nutrition and continence risks requiring coordinated management.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Should classify L4; cross-domain care package required.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Regular assistance with meals and clinically specified swallowing precautions; otherwise moderate needs.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Test that dysphagia modifier adds meal positioning/observation without automatically making L3.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Reduced intake, weight trend concern and declining mobility; emerging skin risk.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Should classify L3 and generate cross-domain monitoring.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Complex/high-risk medication support with regular monitoring, but otherwise moderate ADL needs.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Test that medication complexity drives authorized monitoring/support without double-counting into level.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Near-total assistance with ADLs, transfers, mobility and continence; substantial supervision.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Should classify L4 through high dependency and supervision; verify service capability.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Advanced illness with comfort-focused goals, symptom monitoring and end-of-life pathway; dependency score alone should not determine L5.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Separate L5 pathway should override score-derived L3/L4 when authorized criteria are met.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Previously L3; now functionally improved with fewer assistance needs and stable clinical status.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Test reassessment can reduce level when evidence supports improvement; preserve history/audit trail.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Score lands in L2 range but new acute instability/safety risk requires higher level pending clinical resolution.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Test clinical override/minimum-level rule; final level should not be determined by score alone if safety threshold is exceeded.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: Resident has relatively modest dependency score but is on an authorized comfort/end-of-life pathway.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Critical L5 test: confirms L5 is pathway-based, not score-based.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

scenarios.profile: High dependency and complex care needs but goals are not palliative/end-of-life.
scenarios.expectedTaskLogic: Should remain L4 unless separate L5 criteria are met.
scenarios.expectedEscalation: Apply score validation, modifier rules, capability gate and clinical override as applicable

gaps.requiredDefinition: Validate AS-01 to AS-14 anchors, 56-point threshold bands, minimum-level rules, modifier effects, L5 criteria and inter-rater reliability against real LifeCare resident cases before production.
gaps.affectedAsset: DT-002; Assessment & Care Logic; SLMS classification engine

gaps.requiredDefinition: Define objective override triggers and approval hierarchy
Define clinically/operationally approved frequencies by task/status
Define when a modifier/need makes a level insufficient
Define exact authorized medication-support activities by role
Define clinical precautions, observations and escalation thresholds
Define approved comfort-care tasks, symptom monitoring and escalation
Define severity levels for abnormal events and escalation timing
Define when refusal is routine choice vs safety/clinical escalation
Define start/end dates, review and automatic expiration
Define which tasks require competency before SLMS assignment
Define task completion, exception, outcome and escalation indicators
